saved_arithmetic_audit.independently_recomputed: Train-only scales; saved GN histories/sensitivities to design/rhs; QR reconstruction, orthogonality, triangular equations and iterate updates; initial/reset continuity; trajectory metrics and COI; saved tangent and finite-difference arithmetic; five-point LOS classification summaries and coverage; operation journals and limits.
reported_only: Saved singular spectra, with rank and condition checked arithmetically from those spectra.
Saved energy-identity errors, checked for finite values and the registered threshold.

audit_reconciliation.accepted_scope: Independent confusion matrices, accuracy, coverage and numerical-qualification totals agree with the runtime summaries. The audit requested four fields absent from the runtime schema; that comparison error is sufficient to fail each compound check.
audit_reconciliation.not_closed: The compound check did not save events_ok separately. Exact per-event trigger/time and auxiliary-field equality are not independently closed; reconciliation does not infer them from aggregate agreement.

findings_supported: Three differentiable Gauss-Newton updates using same-stage RK4 tangents recover hidden initial conditions and nonlinear trajectories for the six frozen clean sine-system cases when dynamics are known.
The registered tangent/JVP and two-block, two-step-size finite-difference checks support the end-to-end gradient implementation at the tested states and parameters.
Both parameter groups classify all two cases per role correctly, while perturbed dynamics retain substantial trajectory error. Classification accuracy does not substitute for trajectory accuracy.
claim_boundary: Six fixed clean synthetic cases, with one stable and one unstable event per role, validate the nonlinear history interface. There was no nonlinear parameter fit, real-data evaluation, noise study, general identification proof or stability certificate.

requirements: Add a frozen-roster reader for TASK3 train 346, val 107 and test 76; preserve the historical source-train-only reader and consumed scopes.
Preserve the 100 ms/11-frame causal input, physical units and COI transformations; keep future availability and official labels in scoring only.
Freeze a sourced real visible backbone and one bounded g/tau training schedule, then review the exact new implementation, data-read scope and budget.
Attempt every val/test event after the fixed training endpoint, retaining numerical failures and unsettled predictions; report trajectory errors and stability confusion/coverage together.

review_operations.inputs: Saved JSON, bound source, audit script and byte hashes.
